policies.title: Release policies
policies.subtitle: Rules a candidate must pass before it ships.
policies.empty: No release policies yet. Start from the default rules, then adjust them.
policies.pick: Pick a policy on the left, or create a new one.
policies.fileNameHint: Lower case letters, digits, '-', '_' or '.', ending in .yaml
policies.name: Policy name
policies.onUnknownDefault: Default (small sample warns, missing data blocks)
policies.conditionHint: clean, all, or a condition name; empty uses the primary condition
policies.deleteConfirm: Delete {{file}}? Experiments that reference it will fail to plan.
policies.yamlHint: Edit the YAML directly. The server validates it with the same parser the planner uses.
policies.conflict: Someone saved this policy after you opened it. Reload, then apply your edit again.

releases.verifyHint: Re-hashes every record and evidence pack. Use it before an audit.
releases.complianceHint: Writes compliance-<release>.md and .json into exports/compliance in the project folder.
releases.noReleases: Record a release first; then its compliance pack can be written here.

packs.title: Compliance packs
packs.empty: No compliance pack yet. Pick a release above and press Write compliance pack.

monitors.certifyHint: Scores labelled sealed runs through a monitor and writes a certificate. Runs on a local server only.
monitors.needInput: Fill in a monitor config path and at least one experiment id.
